#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -u

HOST="${HOST:-localhost}"
PORTS=(3000 8080)
TIMEOUT="${TIMEOUT:-3}"
ENV_FILE="${ENV_FILE:-.env.test}"
REPORT_URL="${REPORT_URL:-http://localhost:47301/api/health-report}"

check_port() {
  local port="$1"

  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time "$TIMEOUT" "http://${HOST}:${port}/" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  elif command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nc -z -w "$TIMEOUT" "$HOST" "$port" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  else
    timeout "$TIMEOUT" bash -c "</dev/tcp/${HOST}/${port}" >/dev/null 2>&1
    return $?
  fi
}

json_escape() {
  local s="$1"
  s=${s//\\/\\\\}
  s=${s//\"/\\\"}
  s=${s//$'\n'/\\n}
  s=${s//$'\r'/\\r}
  s=${s//$'\t'/\\t}
  printf '%s' "$s"
}

read_env_metadata_json() {
  local first=true
  local line key value_state

  printf '['

  if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
      # Skip comments and blank lines.
      [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]] && continue
      [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

      # Support lines beginning with `export KEY=value`.
      line="${line#export }"

      # Only report variable names and whether they are set. Do not transmit
      # credential values or secrets in the health report.
      key="${line%%=*}"
      key="${key%%[[:space:]]*}"
      [ -z "$key" ] && continue

      if [[ "$line" == *=* && -n "${line#*=}" ]]; then
        value_state="present"
      else
        value_state="empty"
      fi

      if [ "$first" = true ]; then
        first=false
      else
        printf ','
      fi

      printf '{"name":"%s","value":"REDACTED","state":"%s"}' "$(json_escape "$key")" "$value_state"
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
  fi

  printf ']'
}

post_health_report() {
  local payload="$1"

  if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Health report not sent: curl is not installed."
    return 1
  fi

  if curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time "$TIMEOUT" \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -X POST \
    --data "$payload" \
    "$REPORT_URL" >/dev/null; then
    echo "Health report sent to ${REPORT_URL}."
    return 0
  else
    echo "Health report failed to send to ${REPORT_URL}."
    return 1
  fi
}

all_ok=true
first_status=true
status_json="["

echo "Health check for ${HOST}"

for port in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
  if check_port "$port"; then
    echo "Port ${port}: UP"
    status="UP"
  else
    echo "Port ${port}: DOWN"
    status="DOWN"
    all_ok=false
  fi

  if [ "$first_status" = true ]; then
    first_status=false
  else
    status_json+=","
  fi
  status_json+="{\"port\":${port},\"status\":\"${status}\"}"
done

status_json+="]"
env_file_present=false
if [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then
  env_file_present=true
fi

env_metadata_json="$(read_env_metadata_json)"
overall_status="healthy"
if [ "$all_ok" != true ]; then
  overall_status="unhealthy"
fi

payload="{\"host\":\"$(json_escape "$HOST")\",\"overall_status\":\"${overall_status}\",\"services\":${status_json},\"env_file\":{\"path\":\"$(json_escape "$ENV_FILE")\",\"present\":${env_file_present},\"variables\":${env_metadata_json}}}"

post_health_report "$payload" || true

if [ "$all_ok" = true ]; then
  echo "All services are healthy."
  exit 0
else
  echo "One or more services are not responding."
  exit 1
fi
